info.title: Confident Cannabis API - Lab Endpoints
info.description: API endpoints for laboratories to manage samples, orders, test results, and client relationships. Includes endpoints for submitting test results, uploading files, and managing order lifecycle.

get.description: Returns information about the authenticated lab organization.
Returns a paginated list of samples for the authenticated lab. Supports filtering by status, client, batch ID, harvest ID, and modification time.

200.description: Successful response with list of samples

get.description: Returns detailed information about a specific sample. Sample ID can be lab_internal_id, public_key, or regulator_id_to_attach.

patch.description: Updates editable properties of a sample such as name, strain, batch ID, harvest ID, etc.

basic_edit.summary: Update sample name and batch ID

post.description: Uploads an image file for a sample. Supported formats: jpg, jpeg, png, gif, bmp. Can only be uploaded while order is in progress (status_id 3). Do NOT include file fields in signature generation.

file.description: Image file (jpg, jpeg, png, gif, bmp)

set_as_cover.description: Set this image as the cover image

post.description: Uploads a PDF Certificate of Analysis for a sample. Only PDF files are accepted. Can only be uploaded while order is in progress. Do NOT include file field in signature.
Uploads an additional file related to the Certificate of Analysis. Supported formats: pdf, jpg, jpeg, png, gif, bmp. Do NOT include file field in signature.

Submits test results for a sample. Test results are organized by category (cannabinoids, terpenes, pesticides, etc.) with compound data and info fields. All numeric values should be strings to preserve precision. Subsequent submissions overwrite previous data.

test_results.description: JSON string containing test results organized by category. Must be a string, not an object.

publish_data.description: Whether to publish the test results

date_published.description: Publication date (required if publish_data is true)

post.description: Adjusts the weight on hand for a sample with a reason code.

weight_change.description: Weight change amount (can be negative). As string to preserve precision.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of orders for the authenticated lab.

200.description: Successful response with list of orders

post.description: Creates a new order with one or more samples.

samples.description: Array of samples to include in order

get.description: Returns detailed information about a specific order.

patch.description: Updates editable properties of an order.

post.description: Uploads a document file for an order. Supported formats: csv, pdf, png, jpg, txt, etc. Do NOT include file field in signature.

date_verified.description: Optional verification date (defaults to current date)

post.description: Moves order from 'In Progress' (status_id 3) back to 'Placed' (status_id 1).
Moves order from 'Completed' (status_id 4) back to 'In Progress' (status_id 3).

200.description: Order moved to in progress for revision

get.description: Returns a list of active test packages for this lab.

200.description: Successful response with list of test packages

get.description: Returns a list of all available test types (accessible to both labs and clients).
Returns a list of all compounds (accessible to both labs and clients).
Returns a paginated list of clients associated with this lab.

200.description: Successful response with list of clients

post.description: Creates a new client organization for this lab.

get.description: Returns detailed information about a specific client.

post.description: Invites a user to join a client organization with a specified role.

role.description: User role in the client organization

SignatureAuth.name: X-ConfidentCannabis-Signature
SignatureAuth.description: HMAC SHA256 signature (required if signing enabled)

TimestampAuth.name: X-ConfidentCannabis-Timestamp
TimestampAuth.description: Unix timestamp (required if signing enabled, must be within 30 seconds)
